description: This PHP script retrieves and outputs a configuration template for an issue tracker type within the TestLink project. It initializes the page, processes request parameters, interacts with the tlIssueTracker class to obtain configuration data, and outputs the result as a JSON object.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class responsible for handling issue tracker functionalities within the TestLink system.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Provides the implementation filename for a specific issue tracker type.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Static method that returns the configuration template for the issue tracker.
